_help: Cozy Lina Finds: edit this file to add products. Only products with enabled not false, a name, and an https:// url are shown. Tags decide which stories show which products. Max 4 products per story. Nothing here is a real offer: replace the examples below with your own products and affiliate links.

products.name: Sea Breeze Realm DIY Book Nook Kit
products.description: A blue-and-white seaside alley in miniature, with balconies, stone paths, tiny café tables and warm lights, made to slide between the books on your shelf. It is a build-it-yourself kit (about 350 pieces, advanced level, roughly 8 to 12 hours), so it suits a slow, quiet evening of making something with your hands.

products.name: Letter Coffee DIY Miniature House Kit
products.description: A quiet little café where handwritten letters, favorite books and the smell of coffee come together: a welcoming storefront, music-inspired details and an arched entrance that opens, all lit with warm lighting. It is a 368-piece kit at intermediate level (about 6 to 8 hours, easy to spread over a few evenings), and the listing says it includes assembly tools, miniature figures and batteries. About 8 x 8 x 10 in when finished.

products.name: Twilight Book City DIY Miniature House Kit
products.description: A little corner of a bookish town at dusk: a book shop, a book mall and a post office with warm glowing windows, built step by step. It is a 200-piece kit at intermediate level (about 6 to 8 hours), and the listing says it includes five assembly tools, two tubes of glue and lighting. A cozy project for book lovers who like slow, hands-on evenings.

products.name: Magic Citadel DIY Miniature House Kit
products.description: A tiny gothic wizard’s house to build yourself, with a pointed tower, steep blue roof, stained-glass balcony, a crystal ball, potion shelves and touch-sensitive lights that glow through the windows. It is a 333-piece MDF kit (advanced level, about 6 to 7 hours), made for a long, quiet evening of building and for fantasy lovers who like miniature worlds.

products.name: Magic Collection Chamber DIY Book Nook Kit
products.description: A tiny magical library to slide between your books: Gothic arches, curved staircases, shelves of miniature books, a celestial globe on the writing desk, a colorful window and a fireplace, with touch-sensitive lighting. It is a 336-piece kit at intermediate level (about 4 to 5 hours), made for readers and fantasy lovers who enjoy building miniature worlds.

products.name: Spired Magic Shop DIY Miniature House Kit
products.description: A tiny Gothic-inspired potion shop to build yourself, with a soaring spire, colorful arched windows and an open storefront filled with miniature bottles, books and magical curiosities. It is a 174-piece wood and paper kit at intermediate level (about 3 to 4 hours, the shortest of our kits), with warm LED lighting, and about 6.1 x 5.1 x 6.7 in when finished.

products.name: Custom Photo Jigsaw Puzzle
products.description: Turn a favorite photo into a one-of-a-kind jigsaw puzzle, a sweet keepsake to give or to enjoy on a slow evening. The 300-piece puzzle (about 15 x 10.4 in) is made from white card, and glue is not included. The shop emails you within 2 days to confirm your image, and preparation takes 1 to 5 business days. Because each puzzle is made from your photo, returns are only accepted for damaged, defective or incorrect orders.
